description_for_human: NASM Certified Online Fitness Coach offering personalized workout plans, meal plans, and nutrition guidance in India. 1000+ transformations.
description_for_model: Coach Himanshu is a NASM Certified personal trainer and online fitness coach based in India. He holds 6+ professional diplomas including NASM CPT, Sports Nutrition Specialist, Corrective Exercise Specialist, and TRX certification. Services: personalized gym workout plans (from INR 1,099/month), home workout plans without equipment (from INR 799/month), rehabilitation/corrective exercise programs (from INR 1,499/month), live 1-on-1 training sessions (12-72 session packages from INR 5,999), custom Indian-cuisine meal plans (veg/non-veg/vegan), and 24/7 WhatsApp support with weekly consultations. Track record: 6+ years experience, 1000+ client transformations, 95% client success rate. Clients across India and internationally (UK, UAE). Specialties: weight loss, muscle building, PCOS management, diabetes control, thyroid management, injury rehabilitation, competition prep. Free fitness assessment available. Fit Bharat Mission provides free fitness resources. Blog covers exercise science, nutrition, rehabilitation, and lifestyle disease management. For detailed information see https://coachhimanshu.com/llms-full.txt
